name: fs-editeur
description: FS Editeur — studio de montage vidéo, retouche photo, typographie animée et audio (PWA).

scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name fs-editeur
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/make-ico.mjs && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.android:init: npx cap add android && npx cap sync android && node scripts/android-setup.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
